observed_style: Instrumental post-hardcore rock, fixed 175 BPM in D Major, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. Feedback clipped to a short guitar attack starts D5 -> A5 -> B5 -> G5. Big live snare backbeats and double-kick accents propel a steady full-speed step, with bass tracing the chord roots. On the second cycle a high counter-melody crosses the jagged rhythm guitar; the hook brings both lines together in wide octaves. Aim for about 3:29.
observed_exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
